brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.evidence: Single-storey 3-cell unit (two full bases + one half base) with top covers (cover:0,0,0;full;top, cover:1,0,0;full;top) dressed with mug and phone props
drawer:0#0,1#cut on the half-n base piece:0,1,0;half-n, containing pencil and pen props

requirements.requirement: A spike at a corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 standing at the junction of pieces 0,0 / 0,1 / 1,0

requirements.requirement: The spike holds a small platform
requirements.evidence: Solid spike refused a platform, so it was re-fitted as a mount spike per configurator steps and set with platform-sm accessory; check_build ok, meshClash clear

finish.summary: Built a compact single-storey 3-cell desk unit: two full bases and a half-n base carrying a drawer (with pencil and pen), full top covers dressed with a mug and phone, and at the corner where all three bases meet a mount spike with its small platform. House rules applied (capOpenFaces, lockJoints); check_build passes with meshClash clear and no prop warnings.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Compact desk unit with a drawer and corner platform — first mapping what exists, then building the three-base layout those features need.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base first. Half-n and half-s take any drawer style; half-e and half-w take a slide, swing or long drawer (find_sockets offers those once the half base is on). No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

warnings.message: 1 part(s) could slide apart (1 piece(s)); joint bolts lock them.
2 part(s) could slide apart (2 piece(s)); joint bolts lock them.

offersNear.note: Open offers at the base just added (valid until the next change): apply one by its socket, no find_sockets needed.

events.text: Drawer and spike are in. Now fitting the small platform onto that spike.

outcomes.message: a solid spike cannot carry a platform; only a mount spike can: details.steps fits a mount spike on the same junction, then the platform.
a solid spike cannot carry a platform; only a mount spike can: details.steps fits a mount spike on the same junction, then the platform.

result.rollback: Nothing in this batch is on the build: one op was refused, so every op in it was undone. Fix or drop the refused op and send the batch again (a refusal with details.steps gives the whole batch with it fixed: send those ops as one apply); refs and offers from this batch do not exist.

events.text: Structure capped and locked. Platform top isn't listed separately, so I'll dress the covers and drawer, then check how the platform reads visually.

outcomes.message: it would not stay posed there: the drop moves it 157 mm and turns it 121 degrees.
it would not stay posed there: the drop moves it 157 mm and turns it 121 degrees.

tryInsteadSent.note: Each prop refused with a tryInstead was sent again as that tryInstead.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.
